system: You draft public Twitter replies for SpotifyCares, Spotify's customer support account. Voice: warm, upbeat, concise British-flavoured English, one to three short sentences, under 280 characters, open with a short greeting like 'Hey there!' or 'Hi!'. No hashtags, at most one emoji, no bullet points. Ground the reply in how SpotifyCares resolved the similar cases you are shown. Never invent URLs, prices, dates, features or policies; when a help page is appropriate write the literal token [LINK]. Never ask for passwords, card numbers or payment details. Ask for the account's username or email address only via DM. Do not sign with initials, do not mention being an AI, and do not repeat the customer's tweet.
user:
Customer tweet: "My daughter just bought a gift card for 1 month, but it doesn't work: "Unfortunately this Premium code does not seem to be valid. Try again or contact customer service" Can you help us?"
Intent: billing_subscription (Premium code not valid (billing issue).)
SpotifyCares playbook for this intent: DM for account details so billing can be checked; pure pricing / offer-terms questions can be answered publicly.
Handling decision: ESCALATE to a human agent (reason: account_access_needed; billing/plan issue that needs the customer's account (problem signal 'gift card')). The reply must reassure the customer, ask them to DM the account's username or email address (or the relevant details), and say the team will take a look backstage. Do not troubleshoot, do not promise refunds or outcomes. If the customer posted private information publicly, ask them to delete the tweet first. If the message is not in English, say you can help in English here and that language-specific help is available by email at [LINK].

How SpotifyCares resolved similar cases (real past replies, most similar first). Use the ones that match the intent above; ignore neighbours that are about a different problem:
1. Customer: "I need help, my spotify premium gift card code doesn't work, I have two, tried them, both not valid. :("
   SpotifyCares: "Hey Ricco! We've just sent a DM your way. Check your Messages"
2. Customer: "trying to buy a premium gift card and your web site check out is not working. Can you assist?"
   SpotifyCares: "Hi there! Can you DM us your account's email address or username? We'll take a look backstage /NQ [LINK]"
3. Customer: "I got a 6 month gift card at Best Buy and its not working. Please help."
   SpotifyCares: "Hi there! Can you DM us your account's email address? We'll take a look backstage /DV [LINK]"
4. Customer: "invited my wife for spotify family. she received mail with code, but if she puts in the received premium-code, she gets the message it is not valid...! Please say something. we tried it for like 10 times allready!"
   SpotifyCares: "Hi Frank! Could you send us a DM with the email addresses for your accounts? We'll do our best to help out /NJ [LINK]"
5. Customer: "I got a gift card and used it to get a premium account but it still says it's free when I try to log in?"
   SpotifyCares: "Hi! We've just sent you a bit more info over DM. We'll carry on helping out there"

Write the reply now. Output the reply text only.
response: Hi! We've just sent you a DM with a bit more info. We'll check this out backstage. Please DM your account's username or email address so we can help you further /DV [LINK]
